references.text: Jeremiah also warns against false prophets who can lead the people astray, which reflects Jesus' warning not to be deceived.
Jesus gives a similar warning in Matthew, where he tells the disciples to be on guard against those who will deceive them.
In Luke we find a parallel to Jesus' warning against deception, where he tells them to be on guard against those who come in his name.

Revelation speaks of a white horse whose rider has a bow, and he went out as a conqueror to conquer. This can be interpreted as a warning against deception and false messiah figures, in line with Jesus' warning.
